question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Harmony
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hostility**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Harmony**: Agreement of ideas, feelings, or actions, or a pleasing combination of different parts. (सामंजस्य)
 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options section.
 
 
• **Hostility**: Unfriendly or aggressive behaviour towards people or ideas. (विरोध)
 
• **Congruity**: The quality of being the same as, or in agreement with, other facts or principles. (सर्वांगसमता)
 
• **Consent**: Permission for something to happen or agreement to do something. (अनुमति)
 
• **Concord**: Agreement and peace between countries and people. (एकता)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of '**Harmony**' is '**Hostility**'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
